caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "Humour," displays the performance scores of four different prompts—labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4—on the GEMBA-SQM metric, with the y-axis representing the score ranging from 60.0 to 80.0 in increments of 2.5. The x-axis lists the four prompt variants in order from left to right. Each bar is color-coded: V1 is blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The exact scores are labeled atop each bar: V1 scores 71.4, V2 scores 68.5, V3 scores 71.9, and V4 scores 68.15. The bars are arranged in the order of the prompt labels on the x-axis, not sorted by value, and there are no visual enhancements such as shading or outlines applied to any specific bar.
